verdict.rationale: Thoropass's only documented programmatic surface is its official MCP server. It lets an AI assistant list audits and evidence requests and add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests. There is no evidence that this reaches the many other UI areas (risk register, policies, controls, access reviews, monitors, user management), so UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: documented public REST/GraphQL API, programmatic coverage of risk register, policies, unified controls, access reviews, monitors and admin/user management, an explicit API-parity statement, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: List audits and view audit details ... List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them
Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests
MCP lets the assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace, within limits you set.
